name: Where the Devil Waits
summary: Madam Eva's last card showed where in his castle Strahd will be when the end comes.

stages.journal: Madam Eva's last card showed where the devil will be waiting when we come for him. {tarokka.enemy.hint}
objectives: Find the treasures and the ally before facing Strahd
stages.hint: Gather the Tome, the Holy Symbol, the Sunsword and the ally, then go to Castle Ravenloft. {tarokka.enemy.hint}

stages.journal: We came for Strahd in his castle, where the cards said he would be.
stages.hint: Finish Strahd for good: he goes back to his coffin in his tomb under the castle.

stages.journal: Strahd von Zarovich is destroyed, where the cards said we would find him.
